title: GenerationRequestInput
description: Every model-specific bound (duration, frame rate, resolution, audio sample rate, language set, reference limits, prompt token capacity) belongs to the effective adapter profile and is deliberately absent from this schema.

image_paths.description: One or more still images anchoring subject identity and appearance, all of the same subject. No maximum is fixed here; the effective adapter profile's measured reference limit is the only bound. Exactly one audio reference is accepted; video references are rejected on token cost.

motion_prompt.description: Trimmed and non-empty; no application maximum. Text beyond the effective video adapter's text-encoder capacity is truncated and reported as an explicit override, never silently.

speech_script.description: Trimmed and non-empty; no application maximum and never refused for length. Carried into the prompt as dialogue tags with the selected language, and used with the profile's per-language speaking rate to suggest a duration. Never trimmed, time-stretched, truncated, or partially omitted by the application.

reference_audio_path.description: Voice TIMBRE ANCHOR only. Never played back, never mixed into the output, never treated as spoken content. Should say different words from the speech script; the UI surfaces this rule.

preferred_duration_seconds.description: Operator override for the suggested duration. When null, the suggestion derived from script length and the profile's per-language speaking rate is used. Must fall inside the profile's measured supported range; this schema deliberately encodes no duration bounds of its own, and no request is refused for script length.

guidance_scale.description: Validated against the effective adapter profile's declared bounds, not against any value fixed here.
